findings.message: Some rings have fewer than 3 vertices, so they cannot enclose an area.
findings.hint: Remove those rings or add the missing vertices.

findings.message: Some polygons have no rings, so they have no outline.
findings.hint: Remove those polygons or give each one an outer ring.

findings.message: Some coordinates do not fit EPSG:32640 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 40N): they cannot be converted to valid longitudes and latitudes.
findings.hint: Check that you chose the right coordinate system, for example the right UTM zone and hemisphere, and that X is the easting and Y the northing.
